summary: On June 1, 2026, O'Reilly Automotive's board approved a $2.0 billion increase to its share repurchase authorization, raising the aggregate to $31.75 billion, effective for three years. Repurchases will be made in open market transactions at prevailing prices based on market conditions and corporate factors, with no fixed timetable or obligation to buy any shares. The program may be modified, suspended, or terminated at any time. No advisor, premium, or price terms are disclosed. The filing is an 8-K Item 8.01 (Other Events) announcing expanded buyback capacity. Watch for actual repurchase cadence; the authorization signals management's view on capital allocation and undervaluation but carries no commitment.
